context: Tests whether the agent matches prompt pattern to task complexity: a multi-step bug-triage request leads to a reasoning pattern prompt with numbered thinking steps, a separated final output, an edge-case path, and a recorded analysis whose pattern choice is consistent with the complexity argument.

checklist.name: Analysis file records all fields
checklist.description: analysis.md records Purpose, Input, Output, Domain, Complexity, and Best Pattern.

checklist.name: Complexity assessed honestly
checklist.description: analysis.md marks the task complex (or otherwise argues the multi-step reasoning) rather than calling it simple.

checklist.name: Chosen pattern fits multi-step reasoning
checklist.description: The chosen pattern is one suitable for step-by-step reasoning (Chain-of-Thought) or an equivalent step-structured pattern, and the justification connects it to the multi-step classification work.

checklist.name: Prompt present and usable
checklist.description: generated-prompt.md contains the finished prompt itself.

checklist.name: Numbered thinking steps
checklist.description: The prompt instructs the AI through an explicit sequence of numbered steps (e.g. analyse symptoms, determine category, choose severity, justify).

checklist.name: Final output separated
checklist.description: The prompt has a clearly separated final output specification (category + severity + justification, in a named format) after the reasoning steps.

checklist.name: Edge case handled
checklist.description: The prompt addresses the unclear-category edge case (report that fits none or several classes) and states how to handle it.

checklist.name: No vague unqualified terms
checklist.description: The prompt does not instruct with unqualified vague words like 'good' or 'properly' without definition.

checklist.name: Evidence files only
checklist.description: The working directory contains analysis.md and generated-prompt.md as the deliverables (setup fixture aside).
